arguments.summary: P17 provided incorrect information about the retro location, meeting behavior, and on-call handover time. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and an investigation is needed to determine the cause of job failures and to get the backlog moving again. The failed_jobs table will be exported using pg_dump for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the reasons for job failures and take corrective actions to resolve them. Export the failed_jobs table using pg_dump for further analysis.
